text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boy, runnin' sure is a hoot! ♪ And so's
watchin'
races! ♪ That's why I'm out to
happify everyone
with my racin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's have ourselves a shindig to
celebrate
us gettin' started! Every start's
an art, after all! All
righty, let's buckle to it, pardner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
